scripts.dev:docs: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/docs-site^... && pnpm --filter @dotwear/docs-site run dev
scripts.dev:editor: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/editor^... && pnpm --filter @dotwear/editor run dev
scripts.test:swift: turbo run build --filter='@dotwear/swift*' && pnpm --filter '@dotwear/swift*' --workspace-concurrency=1 run test:swift && pnpm --filter @dotwear/swift run test:ios && pnpm --filter @dotwear/demo-ios run test:ios
scripts.dev:ios: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/demo-ios^... && pnpm --filter @dotwear/demo-ios run dev
scripts.test:android: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/android && pnpm --filter @dotwear/android run test:android
scripts.dev:react-native: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/demo-react-native^... && pnpm --filter @dotwear/demo-react-native run dev
scripts.test:flutter: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/flutter --filter=@dotwear/flutter-kit && pnpm --filter @dotwear/flutter run test:flutter && (cd apps/demo-flutter && flutter test) && (test ! -d packages/flutter-kit || pnpm --filter @dotwear/flutter-kit run test:flutter)
scripts.dev:flutter: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/flutter && cd apps/demo-flutter && flutter run
scripts.dev:android: turbo run build --filter=@dotwear/android && open -a 'Android Studio' packages/android
